name: research-task-system
description: Shared-context research workflows with MATLAB-first computation, validated evidence, and journal-profiled SciencePlots figures.

interface.longDescription: Author current-action TODOs, execute MATLAB-first work/right/fast stages, validate evidence, prepare resumable long runs, and apply journal profiles after complete SciencePlots rendering.
defaultPrompt: Use $research-task-router to turn this research material into an executable TODO with scientific decisions made explicit.
Use $research-task-router to assess this TODO's readiness and recommend an eligible starting path.
Use $research-task-router to carry the recorded stage to its decision boundary with traceable implementation, statistical, and figure evidence.
